svg.title: How the underscore ducks
svg.desc: The underscore level from 3:14 to 3:25 of the video, across the end of section 4, the clip in section 5, and the start of section 6. The level sits at -24 dB, drops to -30 dB under each spoken span and under the whole clip, and comes back up in the short silence after the last word of section 4.
svg.text: UNDERSCORE LEVEL AROUND A CLIP, SCAFFOLD [MIX] SETTINGS
